evidence: compliance.rs:22-30 `require_super_admin` gates access with an EXACT variant match — `match user.role { Some(TenantRole::SuperAdmin) => Ok(()), _ => Err(FORBIDDEN) }` — rather than the hierarchical `has_role`/permission model used elsewhere. This single gate guards all 10 platform-compliance handlers: get_audit_logs (:120), get_audit_summary (:195), get_user_audit_logs (:235), verify_audit_integrity (:287), get_data_export_report (:342), get_deletion_requests_report (:384), get_privacy_settings_report (:442), get_login_activity_report (:518), get_mfa_status_report (:604), get_failed_logins_report (:665) — i.e. the entire GDPR / audit-log / MFA-adoption / login-security dashboard surface.

This exact-match is inconsistent with how the rest of the codebase treats the platform tier. The role model (crates/common/src/tenant.rs:83-114, crates/api-core/src/middleware/authorization.rs:30) is an ordered hierarchy SuperAdmin(100) > PlatformAdmin(95) > OrgAdmin(90) > Manager(80), and every other platform-tier check pairs the two top roles: crates/api-core/src/middleware/rls_context.rs:100,226 and extractors/rls_connection.rs:129,237,399 and extractors/auth.rs:255 all bypass RLS for `SuperAdmin | PlatformAdmin` together; sibling route gate emergency/shared.rs:56-57 admits `SuperAdmin | PlatformAdmin`; listings.rs:1123-1124 documents `has_role` as hierarchical so PlatformAdmin passes. compliance.rs is the lone outlier that hard-denies PlatformAdmin.

Impact is over-restriction, not disclosure: the gate fails CLOSED, so this is a functionality/consistency bug (a PlatformAdmin — a platform-tier operator who already bypasses RLS org-scoping everywhere else — is locked out of the compliance/GDPR/audit tooling) and a maintainability hazard (exact-variant authz silently breaks the hierarchical contract and will mis-behave if the role set is ever extended). Not scored as a security finding because it grants nothing extra.

Fix: replace the exact match with the hierarchical/permission check used elsewhere — either `matches!(user.role, Some(TenantRole::SuperAdmin) | Some(TenantRole::PlatformAdmin))` mirroring emergency/shared.rs, or the shared permission predicate (permissions::SUPER_ADMIN.is_satisfied_by / has_role) so the gate follows the documented hierarchy. Confirm with the owner whether PlatformAdmin exclusion is deliberate; if it IS deliberate, add a code comment saying so, because the current form reads as an oversight against the codebase-wide `SuperAdmin | PlatformAdmin` idiom. Backend-only, single-file change. IG3: a handler/authz test asserting a PlatformAdmin principal reaches (or is intentionally 403'd from) a compliance endpoint — fails today because behavior is untested and diverges from the platform-tier convention.

Confidence medium: the exact-match gate and its 10 call sites are directly read in compliance.rs, and the divergent `SuperAdmin | PlatformAdmin` idiom is confirmed across rls_context.rs / rls_connection.rs / auth.rs / emergency/shared.rs; 'medium' not 'high' because whether locking out PlatformAdmin is intentional product policy vs an oversight requires owner confirmation.
